# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is not a suggestion—it's a battle cry. "Act like men" isn't about bravado or ego; it's a call to spiritual maturity. The world tells you to coast, to numb out, to avoid discomfort. But Christ calls you to stand firm, to be watchful, to lead with strength rooted in faith. Every morning you wake up, you're stepping onto a battlefield. The enemy wants you passive, distracted, and spiritually soft. But you were made for more. Strength isn't the absence of fear—it's choosing faithfulness in the face of it. It's getting up when you'd rather sleep in, opening your Bible when your phone is more appealing, and leading your family when no one's watching. Real strength is discipline applied daily. Today, don't drift. Stand firm. Act like a man of God. The battle is real, but so is your King.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep, thank God for the strength to stand firm in faith today.
